bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge RTL, fatal control conditions such as lc_escalation or sparse FSM integrity failures drive the FSM into StTerminalError and assert sparse_fsm_error_o, but the error-reporting path is incomplete. The StTerminalError state only holds the terminal state and asserts sparse_fsm_error_o; it never populates fsm_err, so error_o remains invalid with ErrNone instead of reporting a fatal error. Additionally, the selected application response computes error as error_i | fsm_digest_done_q only, without including sparse_fsm_error_o, so an application does not receive an error indication when a fatal control fault occurs. The err_code_e enumeration also lacks a dedicated fatal-error code, making it impossible to encode this condition in the error report.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a fatal-error code to kmac_pkg::err_code_e, fill in fsm_err in StTerminalError with valid set, the new fatal-error code, and the offending app_id, and include sparse_fsm_error_o in the app response error assignment so fatal control faults / lc escalation are reported both through error_o and to the selected application interface.
